review.verdict: The cast and concept are on-brief (institution on coins, human trader, AI robot alarm), but the bag of chips — the whole punchline — renders as an unreadable blank white shape, and a badge/building overlap muddies the left side; it isn't ready to publish as-is.
revisionNotes: Recolor the bag-of-chips raw shape so it isn't near-white on cream background; it currently reads as a blank envelope/paper, not a chip bag, which kills the right-side punchline. Add a visible seal/ridge detail.

Fix the safe-area correction on 'safe-badge': it was pushed down 76px and now overlaps the top of the hq component. Shrink hq to scale ~0.55 or move the badge offset so the 'SAFE' tag sits clear above the building with no overlap.

Swap 'hq' for a component that reads as a company headquarters/building rather than a bank of dials/gauges — as rendered it looks like a pressure gauge or control panel, not an institution riding coins to the stock market.
Tighten the chart's attach offset to the trader's raised hand (reduce the [-20] vertical gap) so it visually reads as 'held up' per the brief, instead of floating as a separate element.
Add the thin vertical divider line between the two scenes called for in the brief; right now both halves share one continuous background and the 'elsewhere' split doesn't register.
Pull the two clusters inward slightly (coin-tower group right, robot/bag group left) to close the large empty gap across the middle third and strengthen the single focal composition.

review.verdict: The split-frame idea is sound and the cast is correctly handled, but the two props carrying the joke — the coin tower and the chip bag — don't read as coins or chips, and the floating alarm has no wall to anchor the school setting, so the concept doesn't land without the caption. Also too close in layout to recent split-divider pieces. Does not pass.
revisionNotes: Coin-tower reads as a plain pink capsule, not coins — redesign as a stack of overlapping circular coin discs so the metaphor is legible at a glance.
There is a visible gap between the hq building and the coin-tower beneath it; attach hq flush to the tower top (offset 0) so the building visibly rides the coins.
The alarm robot floats in empty sky with no wall — add a simple flat wall/panel component behind it (attachTo alarm, side back) so the school-wall setting reads without needing the phrase.

The bag of chips renders as a maroon rounded blob (reads as a pillow or wallet); redraw with a clearer crimped zigzag top and a visible seam/sheen so it reads as a chip bag, scale it up slightly (to ~1.0) for legibility.

This vertical-divider split-frame-with-chart-and-robot layout closely repeats at least two recent sloppers (the AI-RULES and PAUSED/TWICE-AS-FAST pieces) — vary the split device (e.g., diagonal line, or scale contrast instead of a straight divider) for novelty.
Trader's raised hand sits right against the dashed divider; nudge the trader anchor left (x 0.38) so the cheering arm doesn't touch the boundary line.

review.verdict: Fails: the casting is right and the style is consistent, but the central punchline prop (the chip bag) is unreadable, the chart floats disconnected from the trader, the coin tower doesn't read as coins, and the brief's divider is missing, leaving an unbalanced, unclear frame.
revisionNotes: The chips bag (bottom right) reads as a heart/clam, not a snack bag — redraw as a wider, flatter sealed pouch with a visible crimped top zigzag, scale to ~1.3, and move it closer under the beam's center so the punchline prop is unmistakable.
Brief calls for a thin divider line splitting the frame left/right; none is present. Add a vertical r-thin line down the center so the two-scene contrast reads instantly.

The chart floats unconnected beside the trader (props.holds is 'none'); attach it to the trader's raised hand/arm (anchor to trader, side: right or top-right, slight overlap) so it visibly reads as 'holding up a chart'.

Coin tower renders as dark overlapping bands that read like tires or a sliced cake, not coins — lighten the fill, add a visible rim/edge per disc, and increase the ellipse height so individual coins are legible.

Composition is top-heavy on the left (badge, HQ, coins, trader stacked) while the right third and bottom are mostly empty background — scale up the alarm/beam/bag group or shift it toward center to balance the square.

This left/right split-screen contrast template is very close to several recent sloppers (AI RULES, TWICE AS FAST, MONTHS AWAY) — vary the layout, e.g. diagonal scale contrast or unequal panel widths, to read as fresh.
